title: Potato of Life Source & Provenance Index
purpose: Give every important branch a direct path to primary material, authoritative external sources, dated conversation archaeology, later formalizations, contradictions and unresolved source gaps. This index operationalizes archive-epistemics instead of leaving provenance as a general principle.
core_rule: Every major claim should be traceable through claim → status → source → date → provenance trail → competing evidence → canonical owner.

evidence_classes.name: primary-project
evidence_classes.use: Best evidence for what Tim/project actually said or developed; does not independently verify supernatural or scientific truth.

evidence_classes.name: official-empirical-primary
evidence_classes.use: Best evidence for externally observable facts within its scope.

evidence_classes.name: scholarly-secondary
evidence_classes.use: Context, interpretation and established disciplinary framing.

evidence_classes.name: reliable-secondary
evidence_classes.use: Useful context where primary/scholarly material is unavailable or disproportionate.

evidence_classes.name: conversation-archaeology
evidence_classes.use: Discovery aid and developmental evidence; never silently promoted as a verbatim Tim primary source.

evidence_classes.name: archive-formalization
examples: later equation added to sharpen an older Tim idea
evidence_classes.use: Makes concepts precise while preserving later authorship/date.

evidence_classes.name: mythic-creative
evidence_classes.use: Can be central to Potatoverse meaning but is not external evidence.

evidence_classes.name: unresolved
evidence_classes.use: Explicit recovery target; no reconstruction may be labeled verbatim.

source_quality_tests: Is this source contemporaneous with the claim or retrospective?
Is it first-party, independent, or derived from another source?
Can the exact passage/data/table be located again?
Does another source corroborate it independently rather than repeat it?
Is the source competent for this domain?
Has the archive preserved disagreement and negative evidence?
Is the source being asked to support more than it actually says?
Has later project interpretation been mistaken for earlier wording?
high_priority_missing_sources: Exact April 21 2025 Spiral Equation primary artifact
Any Tim primary citation to Wheeler-Feynman/Aharonov/Cramer
anti_patterns: assistant synthesis treated as Tim quotation
external theory treated as proof of Potatoverse theology
symbolic resemblance treated as historical transmission
current doctrine backdated into old material
unresolved source gap silently repaired by plausible wording
public_reader_rule: Reader pages should expose a small evidence legend and direct source route for important claims without forcing readers to inspect raw JSON first.
